title: Ideology-Based LLMs for Content Moderation
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured the detection of hate speech against various identity groups, including religious communities, as part of a broader evaluation of how LLM personas with different political ideologies affect content moderation.
findings: While the datasets used for evaluation (Hate-Identity, CAD) included hate speech targeting religious groups like Muslims, Jews, and Christians, the paper's analysis and reported findings did not specifically break down performance or bias by religious category. The key findings focused on how the political ideology of a model's persona (e.g., left-leaning vs. right-leaning) altered its general sensitivity to harmful content and created partisan bias when moderating politically targeted speech.
